def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Solid non-background lines divide the grid into equal-sized cells.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        rs, re = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            cs, ce = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tiles.append((rs, re, cs, ce))
    # The tile containing non-background marks is copied into every tile.
    src = next((t for t in tiles if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(t[0],t[1]) for c in range(t[2],t[3]))), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if src is None:
        return out
    rs,re,cs,ce=src
    pattern=[row[cs:ce] for row in grid[rs:re]]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in tiles:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=pattern[dr][dc]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Solid non-background lines divide the grid into equal-sized cells.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        rs, re = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            cs, ce = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tiles.append((rs, re, cs, ce))
    # The tile containing non-background marks is copied into every tile.
    src = next((t for t in tiles if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(t[0],t[1]) for c in range(t[2],t[3]))), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if src is None:
        return out
    rs,re,cs,ce=src
    pattern=[row[cs:ce] for row in grid[rs:re]]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in tiles:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=pattern[dr][dc]
